facets.label: Funder level
facets.description: What kind of funder it is.

values.label: State
values.description: A state agency or the state's grants portal.

values.label: Community foundation
values.description: A public charity pooling local giving.

values.label: Private foundation
values.description: A private or family foundation, or a music service organization's fund.

values.label: Corporate
values.description: A company's foundation or giving program.

values.label: Open application

values.label: Mixed
